summary: Read the operator's site: 55+ park courting winter seasonal guests and permanent residents ($425/month move-in special 'PERMANENT RESIDENTS ONLY'), with short stays sold nightly on Campspot from 'Starting at $50 Daily' (30- and 50-amp FHU back-in sites; $270-285 weekly). Confirmed Campspot as the booking channel; fees, hookups (20/30/50 amp), laundry and Wi-Fi left as human-checked 2026-10-13. Note unchanged (already says what it mostly is).
flags: Long-stay rule check (AWH 2026-10-14 five tests): this is a 55+ park that mostly sells seasons and permanent residency (home page: '$425/Month Move-In Special', 'PERMANENT RESIDENTS ONLY' for the special, 'Your Seasonal Retreat in Florida', tabs Daily/Weekly/6-Month/Permanent/Summer Monthly/Winter Monthly). Nights are sold on Campspot without an application (test 2 passes; the background/credit check applies only to 6+ month residency), no minimum is stated, and nothing on the site sells homes or lots. Test 1 is marginal: the site says 'Starting at $50 Daily', but Campspot quoted $55 for October 2026 and January 2027 nights (stored fees 50-55, read 2026-10-13), over the US$50 gate, and gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Walt Disney World 68 km).
